text: A patch begins where the selected boundary rule says uncertainty or spacing warrants a new latent token. Local encoders still see every byte.
ROCm maps PyTorch CUDA APIs onto AMD accelerators, while RCCL supplies collective communication among the four local ranks.
Symbols !@#$%^&*() and digits 0123456789 exercise byte identities without requiring a learned subword tokenizer or vocabulary expansion.
This shard is assigned to the second data-parallel worker during the four-GPU training smoke and loops when its rows are exhausted.
